armySpecialRules.name: Blood Frenzy
armySpecialRules.description:
Once a model or unit with this special rule has inflicted
one or more unsaved Wounds, it immediately becomes
subject to Frenzy until the end of the next turn.

armySpecialRules.name: Chameleon
armySpecialRules.description:
Models shooting at a unit with this special rule suffer a
-1 penalty To Hit.

armySpecialRules.name: Firefly Frog Venom
armySpecialRules.description:
Models with this upgrade gain the Poisoned Attacks
special rule for their missile attacks.

armySpecialRules.name: Predatory Fighter
armySpecialRules.description:
Whenever a model with this special rule rolls a 6 To
Hit in close combat, it immediately makes another
Attack; roll To Hit and To Wound as normal. Attacks
generated by the Predatory Fighter special rule do not
generate further Attacks. This applies to all fighting
models in the unit, including models making
supporting attacks.
In addition, a unit that contains one or more models
with this special rule that attempts to restrain pursuit
suffer a Leadership modifier equal to the result they
won the combat against that unit by, just like a
Frenzied unit.

armySpecialRules.name: War Gauntlets
armySpecialRules.description:
Range: Strength: Special Rules:
Combat As user Impact Hits (1),
Parry (6+),
Magical Attacks,
Requires Two Hands
A model with war gauntlets gains +1 Attack.

magicItems.name: Scimitar Of The Sun Resplendent
magicItems.description:
This weapon gives the wielder +2 Attacks and the
Hatred special rule.

magicItems.name: Blade Of Realities
magicItems.description:
No armour or Magical Ward saves can be taken against
Wounds caused by this weapon.

magicItems.name: Blade Of Revered Tzunki
magicItems.description:
This weapon gives the wielder +1 Strength and the
Ignores Armour Saves special rule.

magicItems.name: Stegadon War-Spear
magicItems.description:
Skink High Chief on Stegadon only. Light lance. This
weapon gives the bearer's mount the Impact Hits
(2D6+1) special rule.
magicItems.restriction: Skink High Chief on Stegadon only.

magicItems.name: The Lash Of Itzaotyl
magicItems.description:
This weapon gives the wielder the Always Strikes First
special rule. In addition, any Monster successfully Hit
by this weapon one or more times in a single round
must pass a Leadership test. If failed, it cannot Attack
this close combat phase.

magicItems.name: Sword Of The Hornet
magicItems.description:
This weapon allows the wielder to re-roll 1's To Hit,
and enemies must re-roll 6's To Hit against them.

magicItems.name: The Piranha Blade
magicItems.description:
The wielder has the Multiple Wounds (D3) and Armour
Piercing special rules (1).

magicItems.name: Dagger Of Sotek
magicItems.description:
Skink Only. This weapon gives the wielder the Killing
Blow special rule. In addition, all models from
Warhammer: Skaven treat the model as having the Fear
special rule.

magicItems.name: Burning Blade Of Chotec
magicItems.description:
This weapon gives the wielder the Armour Piercing (2)
and Flaming Attacks special rules.

magicItems.name: Sacrificial Heart Cloth Of Chotec
magicItems.description:
Sling. All shots from this weapon have +1 Strength.
c and powerful magical artefacts used by the
items found in the Warhammer rulebook.

magicItems.name: Staff Of The Lost Sun
magicItems.description:
Skink Priest or Skink High Priest only. This weapon
uses the following profile:
Range: Strength: Special Rules:
18" 5 Multiple Shots (3)
magicItems.restriction: Skink Priest or Skink High Priest only.

magicItems.name: Staff Of Sotek
magicItems.description:
Skink Priest or Skink High Priest only. This weapon
has the following profile:
Range: Strength: Special Rules:
12" 6 Multiple Wounds (D3),
Poisoned Attacks
magicItems.restriction: Skink Priest or Skink High Priest only.

magicItems.name: Sacred Stegadon Helm Of Itza
magicItems.description:
This armour gives the wearer a 6+ armour save. In
addition, they gain +1 Toughness and the Impact Hits
(D3) special rule.

magicItems.name: Hide Of The Cold Ones
magicItems.description:
Oldblood or Scar-veteran on foot only. The wearer of
this armour gains +1 Toughness as well as the Fear,
Natural Armour (5+) and Stupidity special rules.
magicItems.restriction: Oldblood or Scar-veteran on foot only.

magicItems.name: Shield Of Chaqua
magicItems.description:
Shield. All missile attacks targeting the bearer of this
shield or any unit they are with suffer -1 To Wound.

magicItems.name: The Maiming Shield
magicItems.description:
Shield. This armour gives the bearer +1 Attack and the
Magical Attacks special rule.

magicItems.name: Shield Of The Mirrored Pool
magicItems.description:
Shield. Any magic missile that strikes the bearer of this
armour or any unit they are with is reflected on the roll
of 2+ on a D6. If the spell is reflected, the results of the
magic missile are resolved against the caster of the
spell and any unit they are with.

magicItems.name: Coronal Shield
magicItems.description:
Shield. All close combat attacks directed against the
bearer of this shield must re-roll successful rolls To Hit.

magicItems.name: Aura Of Quetzl
magicItems.description:
This talisman gives the wearer the Magical Ward (4+)
special rule against attacks with Strength 5 or more.

magicItems.name: Divine Plaque Of Protection
magicItems.description:
Slann Mage-Priest only. This talisman gives the wearer
and any unit they are with the Magical Ward (5+)
special rule against missile attacks.

magicItems.name: Glyph Necklace
magicItems.description:
All close combat attacks directed against the bearer of
this talisman suffer -1 To Hit.

magicItems.name: Amulet Of Itzl
magicItems.description:
One use only. This talisman automatically ignores the
first unsaved Wound suffered.

magicItems.name: Zoetic Dial
magicItems.description:
The bearer of this item may re-roll 1's when taking
armour saves.

magicItems.name: Incandescent Rectrices
magicItems.description:
One use only. If this model would be removed as a
casualty, immediately roll a D6. On a 3+, the model
remains with 1 Wound, and any additional Wounds
suffered are ignored.

magicItems.name: Crystalline Skull
magicItems.description:
Relic. Each time the bearer of this item successfully
casts a spell, add +1 Power Dice to the pool (to a
maximum of 3 per Magic Phase). In addition, once per
battle the bearer may choose to destroy this item at the
end of any of your Magic phases. If they do so, pick
one enemy unit within 12". Roll a number of dice equal
to the number of Power dice in the pool. For each roll
of a 3+, that unit suffer a Wound that Ignores Armour
Saves.

magicItems.name: Cupped Hands Of The Old Ones
magicItems.description:
Slann Mage-Priest only. Charm. One use only. If the
bearer of this item miscasts, roll a D6. On a roll of 1
the bearer suffers the results of the miscast as normal.
On 2+ the miscast is ignored. In addition, any enemy
Wizards within line of sight of the Slann Mage-Priest
will count as having rolled a 7 on the Miscast table.

magicItems.name: Plaque Of Dominion
magicItems.description:
Relic. Bound spell (Level 2, cast on 8+). This item
contains a hex aura spell with a range of 18". All
enemy Wizards within range have the Stupidity special
rule until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

magicItems.name: Rod Of The Storm
magicItems.description:
Staff. Bound Spell. This item contains the Urannon's
Thunderbolt spell from the Lore of Heavens.

magicItems.name: The Tetragon Of Tectonic Displacement
magicItems.description:
Relic. Bound Spell. The Tetragon of Tectonic
Displacement contains the Tectonic Shift spell from the
Lore of Geomancy.

magicItems.name: Cube Of Darkness
magicItems.description:
Charm. One use only. When an enemy spell has been
cast, a Wizard with this item can use it instead of
attempting to dispel the spell using dispel dice. If he
does so, roll a D6; on the roll of a 2+ the spell is
automatically dispelled - otherwise the spell is
resolved as normal. In either case, roll a separate D6
for every Remains in Play spell currently in effect; on a
2+ that spell automatically ends.

magicItems.name: Plaque Of Xoloc
magicItems.description:
Charm. Once use only. This item may be used before
attempting to cast any spell with a casting value of 10
maximum. Once used, the spell is cast automatically
without using any Power dice. It may be dispelled as
normal on its minimum casting value.

magicItems.name: Diadem Of Power
magicItems.description:
Relic. This item allows you to save up to two unused
Power dice at the end of your Magic phase and add
them to your side's Dispel dice pool in the next enemy
Magic phase.

magicItems.name: Plaque Of Tepee
magicItems.description:
Relic. Every time an enemy spell targets the wearer or
their unit, roll a D6. On a 5+, the spell is dispelled and
has no effect. If the roll is failed, you may attempt to
dispel the spell as normal.

magicItems.name: Plaque Of Tepok
magicItems.description:
Slann Mage-Priest only. Relic. The model bearing this
item can choose an additional spell from another Lore
of Magic than the one they have chosen.

magicItems.name: Coatl Familiar
magicItems.description:
Charm. One use only. This item can be used at the start
of any of your Magic phases. When used, the bearer
may attempt to cast any one spell from any Lore of
Magic normally available to them.

magicItems.name: Blood Statuette Of Spite
magicItems.description:
Bound Spell (Level 2, cast on 7+). This item contains a
direct damage spell with a range of 12" that targets
one enemy model, even in a unit. The target model
must pass a Toughness test or suffer a Wound which
Ignores Armour Saves. If the model takes a Wound
from this spell, it must immediately take another
Toughness test, losing another Wound if it fails again.
This continues until either the model passes a
Toughness test or is slain.

magicItems.name: Prism Of Amyntok
magicItems.description:
Slann only. Bound spell (Level 2, cast on 8+). This
item contains a direct damage area spell that uses the
line template. Place it 12" in length, directly away from
the caster's front arc. Each model in the way suffers a
Strength 6 Hit with the Flaming Attacks special rule.
This has a +1 bonus To Wound against Daemons,
Undead and Vampires.

magicItems.name: The Cloak Of Feathers
magicItems.description:
Skink character on foot only. This item gives the
wearer the Fly (10) and Magic Resistance (1) special
rules.

magicItems.name: The Egg Of Quango
magicItems.description:
One use only. This item can be used at the start of any
Close Combat phase. Nominate one enemy unit in base
contact with the bearer or his unit, roll a D6 and
consult the table below to find out what happens. Any
Wounds inflicted count towards combat results.
D6 Result
1 The enemy unit immediately suffers D6
Strength 3 hits.
2-3 The enemy unit immediately suffers D6
Strength 4 hits.
4-6 The enemy unit immediately suffers 2D6
Strength 5 hits.

magicItems.name: The Horn Of Kygor
magicItems.description:
One use only. The bearer of this item can sound it at
the start of any of his Movement phases. If they do so,
all friendly mounts, War Beasts, Monstrous Beasts and
Monsters within 12" of the bearer have the Frenzy
special rule until the start of their next Movement
phase.

magicItems.name: Gleaming Pendant Of Chotec
magicItems.description:
One use only. This item may be used at the start of any
close combat phase. For the remainder of the phase, all
enemy units in base contact with the wearer or the unit
it is with gain the Always Strikes Last special rule.

magicItems.name: Star Tablet
magicItems.description:
Infantry only. Before deployment, the bearer of this
item and one unit they must join gains the Scouts
special rule.

magicItems.name: The Incantation Of Xetlipocutzl
magicItems.description:
One use only. The bearer can use this item at the start
of any of your Magic phases. All enemy units within
12" must immediately take a Panic test using an
additional D6, discarding the lowest result.

magicItems.name: Throne Of The Lost Gods
magicItems.description:
Slann Mage-Priest only. The model gains +1 Wound
and the Fly (8) special rule.

magicItems.name: Charm Of The Jaguar Warrior
magicItems.description:
Saurus on foot only. This item gives the bearer
Movement 8 and the Scouts special rule.

magicItems.name: Curse-Charm Of Tepok
magicItems.description:
One use only. When an enemy Wizard rolls on the
Miscast table, the bearer of this item may force them to
re-roll the result.

magicItems.name: Bane Head
magicItems.description:
The bearer of this item gains the Multiple Wounds (2)
special rule against one enemy model, nominated at the
start of the battle.

magicItems.name: Carnosaur Pendant
magicItems.description:
Saurus Oldblood or Scar-Veteran. The bearer of this
item gains the Blood Frenzy special rule.

magicItems.name: Plaque Of Fate
magicItems.description:
The bearer of this item may re-roll one roll To Hit, To
Wound, armour or invulnerable save per turn.

magicItems.name: Relocation Orb
magicItems.description:
Slann only. One use only. If the bearer of this item has
suffered any unsaved Wounds at the end of any phase,
they may be moved anywhere within 12" just like a
summoning spell, even if they are in combat.

magicItems.name: Sotek'S Gaze
magicItems.description:
Skink only. This item gives the wearer the Fear special
rule

magicItems.name: War Drum Of Xahutec
magicItems.description:
All friendly units within 12" of the bearer of this item
do not need to pass a Leadership test in order to march,
regardless of the proximity of enemy units. In addition,
they gain +1 Leadership when attempting to Rally.

magicItems.name: Dragonfly Of Quicksilver
magicItems.description:
If both players have models with the Scouts special
rule, the Lizardmen player adds +1 to their dice roll
when rolling to see who deploys their Scouts first.

magicItems.name: Totem Of Prophecy
magicItems.description:
All enemy units with Line of Sight to this standard
suffer a -1 penalty to their Leadership. This standard
has no effect on models with Immunity (Psychology).

magicItems.name: Huanchi'S Blessed Totem
magicItems.description:
Bound Spell, (Level 3, cast on 9+). This standard
contains a conveyance spell that targets the unit
carrying it. The unit may immediately make a move
directly forward using the Random Movement (2D6)
special rule.

magicItems.name: Sun Standard Of Chotec
magicItems.description:
All missile attacks targeted at the unit carrying this
standard from within 12" suffer -2 To Hit, or -1 To Hit
if fired from over 12" away.

magicItems.name: Skavenpelt Banner
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard gains the Frenzy and
Hatred (Skaven) special rules. However, all models
from Warhammer: Skaven gain the Hatred special rule
against the unit carrying the banner.

magicItems.name: The Jaguar Standard
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard adds D3" to their charge
or pursue distance.

magicItems.name: Sign Of Sotek
magicItems.description:
Skinks only. The unit carrying this standard may re-roll
failed rolls To Wound on any turn it charges.

loresOfMagic.name: Geomancy
loresOfMagic.attribute:
Every time a spell from the Lore of Geomancy is
successfully cast on an enemy unit or a unit suffers one
or more unsaved Wounds from it, that unit suffers -1 to
its Movement value until the start of the caster's next
Magic phase. This has no effect on models with the Fly
or Strider special rules.

disciplines.name: The Focused Rumination
disciplines.description:
Once per Magic phase, the Slann may add an
additional 'free' Power dice to the casting attempt. This
can cause a Miscast or Ultimate Power as normal, and
can cause the Mage-Priest to roll more dice than
normally allowed.

disciplines.name: Focus Of Mystery
disciplines.description:
The Slann Mage-Priest has the Loremaster special rule.
This discipline cannot be combined with the Wandering
Deliberations or Deep Contemplations disciplines.

disciplines.name: Harmonic Alignment
disciplines.description:
The Slann Mage-Priest gains a +1 bonus to channel
power and dispel dice.

disciplines.name: Becalming Cogitation
disciplines.description:
The Slann Mage-Priest re-rolls its first failed dispel
attempt in each Magic phase.

disciplines.name: Soul Of Stone
disciplines.description:
When rolling on the Miscast table, the Slann Mage-
Priest can choose to subtract 1 from the result (to a
minimum of 2) or add 1 to the result (to a maximum of
12), instead of accepting the original result.

disciplines.name: Wandering Deliberations
disciplines.description:
The Slann Mage-Priest may choose their spells from a
combination of any of the eight Winds of Magic in the
Warhammer rulebook. However, they may only choose
one Signature Spell. This discipline cannot be
combined with the Focus of Mystery or Deep
Contemplations disciplines.

disciplines.name: The Harrowing Scrutiny
disciplines.description: The Slann Mage-Priest has the Terror special rule.

disciplines.name: Higher State Of Consciousness
disciplines.description:
The Slann Mage-Priest has the Ethereal special rule,
but cannot join units.

disciplines.name: Transcendent Healing
disciplines.description:
If this model is alive at the end of any friendly Magic
phase, roll a number of D6 equal to the difference
between the Slann Mage-Priest's starting number of
Wounds and its current number of Wounds. For each
roll of a 6, the Slann Mage-Priest immediately recovers
a single Wound lost earlier in the battle.

disciplines.name: Deep Contemplations
disciplines.description:
Whenever the Slann Mage-Priest successfully casts a
spell, they can immediately choose one of the
Signature Spells from one of the eight Winds of Magic
in the Warhammer rulebook which they can cast for the
remainder of the Magic phase. That newly chosen spell
will always use that spell lore's lore attribute. This
discipline cannot be combined with the Focus of
Mystery or Wandering Deliberations discipline.

disciplines.name: Reservoir Of Eldritch Energy
disciplines.description:
At the end of the opponent's Magic phase, the Slann
Mage-Priest can store a single unused dispel dice
remaining in your pool. At the beginning of your next
Magic phase, roll a D6; on a 2+ you can add that dice
to your power pool. On the roll of a 1, that bonus dice
is lost. If the Slann is slain before their next Magic
phase, the bonus dice is lost.

disciplines.name: Unfathomable Presence
disciplines.description:
Roll a D3 at the start of each enemy Magic phase; the
Slann Mage-Priest has the Magic Resistance (*) special
rule until the end of that phase, where the result of 1
gives Magic Resistance (1), a result of 2 gives Magic
Resistance (2) and a result of 3 gives Magic Resistance
(3).

disciplines.name: Vast Intellect
disciplines.description:
The Slann Mage-Priest can choose one additional spell.
